title: Martyx Industries
lead: We engineer 3D‑printed RC platforms and parts that are easy to build, maintain, and upgrade. Designed, tested, and refined so you can spend more time driving and less time troubleshooting.

precision.title: Engineering Precision
precision.description: CAD-designed components with perfect hardware compatibility and optimal performance.

quality.title: Tested Quality
quality.description: Every design is stress-tested and refined through real-world testing and feedback.

support.title: Complete Support
support.description: Comprehensive documentation, BOMs, and community support for all your builds.

story.title: Our Story
story.description: Born from a passion for RC engineering, we combine modern 3D printing technology with precision design to democratize high-quality RC vehicle construction for enthusiasts worldwide.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.description: We combine passion for RC modeling with cutting-edge 3D printing technology. Our STL files are designed with maximum attention to detail, optimized for easy printing and perfect results.

why.title: Why choose us?
why.description: With more than 5 years of experience in 3D modeling and RC modeling, we bring you proven solutions that work. We test each model on different types of printers and materials.

cta.title: Ready to start your project?
cta.description: Explore our collection of premium STL models and start creating amazing RC models today!
